scope: Extend classic polygon-mesh writer transaction evidence beyond the existing square 2x2 profile to a rectangular 3x2 grid with both M and N closure flags.

source.kind: deterministic locally-authored records generated during each test run
source.profile: POLYGONMESH parent flags 16|1|32, M vertex count 3, N vertex count 2, and six WCS coordinate vertices arranged in a rectangular grid.

implementation.method: Calibrate complete whole-file writes for each version and encoding, inject std::bad_alloc at every reached allocation, require unchanged caller topology/coordinates and destination sentinel, retry using the same codec, compare exact bytes, and read back mesh header fields and all six vertices. Caller-state checks for the topology matrix now validate flags, root elevation, vertex coordinates, identifiers, and polyface indices.

limitations: Generated DXF transport and transaction evidence only; producer interoperability and native CAD mesh interpretation are not qualified.
The tested rectangular profile does not cover arbitrary mesh dimensions, independent closure combinations, or spline-fit mesh variants.
No support claim is promoted and no DWG/DXF fixture is committed.

planImpact.completedSlice: Rectangular 3x2 POLYGONMESH with M/N closure bits roundtrips transactionally in ASCII/Binary across AC1014, AC1021, AC1024, AC1027, and AC1032.
planImpact.remainingP6G: Continue the public-writer inventory for other compound-record variants and variable-size OBJECTS builders; retain source-profile and semantic gates.
planImpact.progressEstimate: 186 completed slices and 35 remaining packages: 186/(186+35)=84.2%; count-based, not effort-weighted.
